dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、お弁当美味しかったでしょ？」

屋上からの帰り道、まだ人気の少ない廊下で、
さくらが笑う。
dialogues.en:
What was left of the school day passed by, and it was time
to go home...
dialogues.text:
What was left of the school day passed by, and it was time
to go home...

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en:
And once school was no longer there to distract me, my
thoughts wandered back to the events in the morning. What a
headache.
dialogues.text:
And once school was no longer there to distract me, my
thoughts wandered back to the events in the morning. What a
headache.

dialogues.jp: 繋いだ手は温かい。
dialogues.en:
Even now, I was lying on my bed, staring at the ceiling, and
thinking of that.
dialogues.text:
Even now, I was lying on my bed, staring at the ceiling, and
thinking of that.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あれはね、屋上で青い空の下で食べるから、
　美味しいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
I can't even remember whether I ate anything, but since my
stomach isn't complaining, I probably have.
dialogues.text:
I can't even remember whether I ate anything, but since my
stomach isn't complaining, I probably have.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうか……まぁ、屋上に出るまでが面倒だが
　な」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「苦労するほど見返りが大きいんだよ。山に登っ
　て食べるお弁当だって美味しいでしょ？」
dialogues.en: I closed my eyes, and took a long breath.
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes, and took a long breath.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それでも、やっぱり降りるのが面倒だな。
　あぁ、この学園、上下の移動はエレベーター
　にならないかな？」
dialogues.en: I unconciously brought my fingertip to my lips.
dialogues.text: I unconciously brought my fingertip to my lips.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……ならないよ」
dialogues.en:
As if my subconcious was lamenting the theft of my first
kiss.
dialogues.text:
As if my subconcious was lamenting the theft of my first
kiss.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en:
One could say that "There's nothing you can do about it",
but the sensation in my lips wouldn't fade so easily.
dialogues.text:
One could say that "There's nothing you can do about it",
but the sensation in my lips wouldn't fade so easily.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは、そうだよ」
dialogues.en:
Kudou's female-like sigh, slender arms, and neither cold nor
warm, soft lips...
dialogues.text:
Kudou's female-like sigh, slender arms, and neither cold nor
warm, soft lips...

dialogues.jp: 別になんでもない話題だった。
dialogues.en: "It felt... really good."
dialogues.text: "It felt... really good."

dialogues.jp:
でも、さくらは楽しそうに笑っているし、俺も
意味もなく面白かった。
dialogues.en:
Although those words came out of my own mouth, I was still
astonished to hear them.
dialogues.text:
Although those words came out of my own mouth, I was still
astonished to hear them.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……もうすぐ人がいる場所に出ちゃう」
dialogues.en:
My heart started beating furiously. My cheeks were slowly
turning red.
dialogues.text:
My heart started beating furiously. My cheeks were slowly
turning red.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: ...Maybe I have arrhthymia?
dialogues.text: ...Maybe I have arrhthymia?

dialogues.jp:
さくらが立ち止まり、手を繋いでいた俺も足を
止めざるを得なかった。
「もう少しここにいるか？」
dialogues.en: "Of course not."
dialogues.text: "Of course not."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん♪」
dialogues.en: I have to stop lying to myself.
dialogues.text: I have to stop lying to myself.

dialogues.jp:
教室の壁に寄りかかって、ぼう、と俺は窓の外
を見つめる。
dialogues.en: I rose from the bed into a sitting position.
dialogues.text: I rose from the bed into a sitting position.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが関わっているとされる事件を調べる時
間は、ついに１０日を切った。
dialogues.en: I didn't like it, but I had to accept it--
dialogues.text: I didn't like it, but I had to accept it--

dialogues.jp:
こいつは知っているのだろうか。このままでは、
自分が叶えた夢が潰されることを。
dialogues.en: "He's been on my mind the entire time..."
dialogues.text: "He's been on my mind the entire time..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは」
dialogues.en:
It was strange coming out of my own mouth. But I couldn't
deny the truth of that statement.
dialogues.text:
It was strange coming out of my own mouth. But I couldn't
deny the truth of that statement.

dialogues.jp: 俺を見上げて笑うさくら。
dialogues.en:
It all started at the park, when Kudou told me that "The one
I like is you.".
dialogues.text:
It all started at the park, when Kudou told me that "The one
I like is you.".

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
At that time, my normal self was thrown for a loop, and a
door I had thought was shut firmly, was forcibly opened.
dialogues.text:
At that time, my normal self was thrown for a loop, and a
door I had thought was shut firmly, was forcibly opened.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いけない関係」
dialogues.en:
Yet the feelings I got from behind the door aren't things
that I dislike...
dialogues.text:
Yet the feelings I got from behind the door aren't things
that I dislike...

dialogues.jp:
さくらが自分の鼻を指さして、それから俺の胸
にその指を当てる。
dialogues.en:
I knew this deep inside, and my cheeks easily showed the
proof as well.
dialogues.text:
I knew this deep inside, and my cheeks easily showed the
proof as well.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうだな」
dialogues.en: "But that's, that's... wrong..."
dialogues.text: "But that's, that's... wrong..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ……ん」
dialogues.en: Kudou is definitely cute.
dialogues.text: Kudou is definitely cute.

dialogues.jp: 精一杯背伸びして、さくらが俺にキスをする。
dialogues.en:
Such long eyelashes and tender cheeks, a bishounen that
shouldn't have been born a man. That I can agree to.
dialogues.text:
Such long eyelashes and tender cheeks, a bishounen that
shouldn't have been born a man. That I can agree to.

dialogues.en:
Yet, even though he's very much "bi", the "shounen" is the
complicated part...
dialogues.text:
Yet, even though he's very much "bi", the "shounen" is the
complicated part...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……なに赤くなってるの？」
dialogues.en: Since it's always used in reference to males...
dialogues.text: Since it's always used in reference to males...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、どうにも慣れなくてさ」
dialogues.en: That's right... he's a guy... that's why I...
dialogues.text: That's right... he's a guy... that's why I...

dialogues.jp:
口元を押さえているように見せかけて、熱い頬
を隠す。
dialogues.en: "What am I doing..."
dialogues.text: "What am I doing..."

dialogues.jp:
つまり、その……俺の胸までしか背がないさく
らの、爪先立ちの姿が恥ずかしくて仕方ないの
だ。
dialogues.en: I moaned, rubbing my head and hair vigourously.
dialogues.text: I moaned, rubbing my head and hair vigourously.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんしょ」
dialogues.en:
I kept repeating to myself, I like cute girls, trying to
force it into my mind.
dialogues.text:
I kept repeating to myself, I like cute girls, trying to
force it into my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おっ」
dialogues.en: Then, my anger started to build.
dialogues.text: Then, my anger started to build.

dialogues.jp: ぐっ、と首をつかまれて前屈みにされる。
dialogues.en: Why am I the only one who has to deal with these feelings...
dialogues.text: Why am I the only one who has to deal with these feelings...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちゅー♪」
dialogues.en: Kudou himself doesn't have a clue about what he did.
dialogues.text: Kudou himself doesn't have a clue about what he did.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……俺からしろというのか」
dialogues.en: He may be completely clueless,
dialogues.text: He may be completely clueless,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「早く早く！　もう昼休みが終わっちゃうよ？」
dialogues.en:
But that takes nothing away from the fact that he stole my
first kiss.
dialogues.text:
But that takes nothing away from the fact that he stole my
first kiss.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……こほん」
dialogues.en: "The way it is, I can't stay quiet about it much longer."
dialogues.text: "The way it is, I can't stay quiet about it much longer."

dialogues.jp:
辺りの様子を見渡して、人がいないことを確か
めて咳払いをする。
dialogues.en: Accept the crime, demand an apology... and...
dialogues.text: Accept the crime, demand an apology... and...

dialogues.jp: 学園の中というだけで、こう、恥ずかしい。
dialogues.en: "I can't say it!! I definitely can't talk about THAT!!"
dialogues.text: "I can't say it!! I definitely can't talk about THAT!!"

dialogues.en: I can't do that. Impossible.
dialogues.text: I can't do that. Impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
細い腰に手を回して、本当に本当に、やさしく
引き寄せた。
dialogues.en:
Tomorrow... how am I going to be able to face him
tomorrow...
dialogues.text:
Tomorrow... how am I going to be able to face him
tomorrow...

dialogues.jp: さくらはその名の通り、春みたいに暖かかった。
dialogues.en: ◆Strange? Love?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Strange? Love?◆

dialogues.jp: ◆廊下でちゅー◆
dialogues.en: And, why does my chest feel so strange...
dialogues.text: And, why does my chest feel so strange...

dialogues.jp:
人気のない屋上でさくらと弁当を食べ、廊下で
キスをする。
dialogues.en:
And Kudou has no idea of the troubles I'm going through
now...
dialogues.text:
And Kudou has no idea of the troubles I'm going through
now...

dialogues.jp:
恋人同士になったふたりは、まぁ、いちゃいちゃ
するのは仕方ないのだろう……うん。
dialogues.en:
How am I supposed to face him tomorrow... I spent the whole
night worrying and thinking about things like that.
dialogues.text:
How am I supposed to face him tomorrow... I spent the whole
night worrying and thinking about things like that.
